reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: The canonical cover is a monochrome collage of THREE Vergil sculpture views, with different arms and ornate skull/monster pedestals. Source view 1 is a colored closeup of short pale-haired Vergil, and views 2–5 show a single lunging/crouched blue-coated Vergil drawing a katana above an orange ring of flames on a flat VERGIL nameplate. Neither pose, pedestal, sword placement nor the prominent fire arc matches the reviewed canonical cover. Source's other camera angles corroborate. The one published same-name candidate is not proven to be the same sculpture; other historical variants remain unsearched.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Manual comparison across verified source views and canonical R2 cover. SHA-256, dHash, sculpture, pose, costume and base are evidence; similar character names and hashes never by themselves authorize mapping or new publication.

mediaReview.notes: Third-party studio lion insignia, web/social handles, Patreon promotion, and print-test labeling are visible in the source images. The published cover also shows creator branding. No new image use, watermark removal, crop, cover replacement, upload or gallery promotion authorized.

decision.nextGate: Search other published variants and historical aliases, checking actual sculptures; absence of a match among one current candidate cannot approve a new model.
